subject: [PATCH v2 2/3] nfsd: accept a backdated timestamp from a delegation holder

2026-09-02.patch_summary: This patch allows the NFS server to accept a backdated timestamp from a delegation holder, which was previously ignored if it moved backwards in time. The client can report file times at every delegation return, and the server will update them accordingly. If an mtime moves backwards, the ctime is set to the current time. The patch also fixes issues with caching and attribute updates when using delegations.
